round.description: Audit round, matching the id prefix of every finding.

findings.description: Proposals for the author. Empty is a valid result.

control.description: The NFR-2 control, or the NFR-1/NFR-3 budget this misses.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, where one applies. A gap that is the absence of code has none.

failureScenario.description: A concrete input or state, and the wrong result it produces.

repro.description: The exact command, and the output that shows it failing. No repro, no finding.

measurement.description: The number, with its unit and the conditions it was taken under; 'n/a' only for a binary control.

budgets.description: Every budget in NFR-1..3, answered met or missed with the number that answers it.

budget.description: The budget as the PRD states it.

measured.description: What was measured, with its unit.

note.description: Required in spirit when met is false: why it was not met.

breakingPoint.description: Where one process stopped meeting the budget, and why it stopped. Load track only.

deployReady.description: Whether the application is deploy-ready as it stands.
